title: CVE-2026-118527: Ivanti — Connect Secure (Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability)

topic.reason: Sicherheitsentwicklungen, Schwachstellen, Schutz (Treffer: cve-, vulnerability, exploit, security, patch)

summary: Aktiv ausgenutzte Schwachstelle (CISA KEV). Betroffen: Ivanti Connect Secure. Bekannt seit 2026-10-30. Hinweis: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357. Erforderliche Massnahme: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
